overview: TradeNest Naturals supplies dehydrated beetroot flakes from India for bulk and export requirements. The product is processed through sourcing, cleaning and sorting, controlled drying, grinding and sieving when needed, quality inspection, and packing and dispatch. It is offered for food manufacturing, wholesale, and private-label programs with support for custom mesh and packaging on request.

Our dehydrated beetroot flakes are supplied as clean, free-flowing pieces for industrial use. The standard mesh size is 4-8 mesh, with moisture at ≤ 8% and shelf life up to 12 months when stored in a cool, dry place away from sunlight and moisture. MOQ starts at 5 Kg, with OEM support, samples on request, and export documentation support available.

faqs.q: What is the MOQ for dehydrated beetroot flakes?

faqs.a: The standard mesh size is 4-8 mesh, and custom mesh can be arranged on request.

faqs.q: What packaging options do you offer?
faqs.a: We offer 25 kg bags, HDPE containers, 5-10 kg bags, and small private-label pouches and jars.

faqs.q: Can you support OEM or private label orders?
faqs.a: Yes. OEM and private label supply is available, with branding and packaging support on request.
